title: Q-ROLE-sales-partnerships: sales and partnerships has no automated role and no code
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** phase 2 gate passes (python3 -m foundation team --gate)
**Done check:** cmd:git ls-files --error-unmatch agents/roles/sales-partnerships.md
**Status:** closed

ROLE-ALIGN-1, MANAGERS-1, TEAM-1. The coverage map in doctrine/managers.json (`software_roles`, id `sales-partnerships`) is a gap: the outreach manager's intro lane (scripts/outreach_intro.py) introduces the work to organizations, and nothing keeps a lead list with a next step per lead, prepares a discovery call or tracks a partner programme. The role is defined in doctrine/team.json (phase 2, metric leads_with_next_step) and its activation item OL-ROLE-sales-partnerships ended shelved.

When the phase 2 gate of `python3 -m foundation team --gate` is open, run `python3 -m foundation team --apply` (role files, seed role, loop entry), give the role a row in doctrine/managers.json (runs, clock, probe, settles, human_role, decides, inputs, hands_to, cadence) and in seed/autonomy/managers.json, and set the `sales-partnerships` row of `software_roles` to covered with the code the role owns.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:git ls-files --error-unmatch agents/roles/sales-partnerships.md

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`; this item closing by its done check keeps the share of well-specified open items at or above today's reading)

**Out of scope:** activating the role ahead of its phase gate, creating the phase 1 handoff files only to open the gate, contacting a person outside the outreach caps and suppression rules, or any statement or commitment in the owner's name.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:10:18Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
